achievements.name: First Partner
achievements.detail: Choose Sprigatito, Fuecoco, or Quaxly as your starter.

achievements.name: Terastallize
achievements.detail: Terastallize a Pokémon during a battle.

achievements.name: Ride Miraidon
achievements.detail: Ride Miraidon across the Paldea region.

achievements.name: First Badge
achievements.detail: Defeat a Gym Leader and earn a Paldea Gym Badge.

achievements.name: Eight Badges
achievements.detail: Collect all eight Paldea Gym Badges.

achievements.name: Paldea Champion
achievements.detail: Defeat the Elite Four and Top Champion Geeta.

achievements.name: Titan Pokémon
achievements.detail: Defeat a Titan Pokémon on the Path of Legends.

achievements.name: Path of Legends
achievements.detail: Defeat all five Titan Pokémon and finish the Path of Legends.

achievements.name: Team Star Base
achievements.detail: Clear a Team Star base by winning its Star Barrage and boss fight.

achievements.name: Starfall Street
achievements.detail: Defeat every Team Star boss and complete Starfall Street.

achievements.name: Pokédex 100
achievements.detail: Register 100 Pokémon in the Paldea Pokédex.

achievements.name: Area Zero
achievements.detail: Enter Area Zero and reach the laboratory at the bottom of the crater.
